summary: Nu Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the results of its annual general meeting held on August 6, 2026. Shareholders approved ratification of audited financial statements and Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 (99.88% in favor) and re-election of nine directors (96.23% in favor). This is a routine corporate governance matter with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review. The filing is an ordinary disclosure of meeting results, not a catalyst for a deal or restructuring. What to watch: no further action expected; the company continues normal operations.
